chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Al-Hasan Al-Hazramy, from the one who informed him, from Ali ibn Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) who said:
The wine is from five things: from dates, raisins, wheat, barley, and honey.
ai.seo_question: What are the five ingredients from which wine is made according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the five primary sources of khamr—dates, raisins, wheat, barley, and honey—forming the basis for the Shia juristic classification of intoxicants. By linking these specific agricultural products to the prohibition of wine, it provides a clear material criterion for determining ritual purity and the validity of consumption in fiqh.
